description: Document operational procedures for ZO-SENTINEL. Must include: (1) supervisord config location and daemon list (check supervisord_sentinel_full.conf). (2) Log locations for each daemon (find via LOG_DIR constants in each file). (3) Recovery runbook: if write_service stale — check DuckDB accessibility via ws_query, verify port 8772 is listening (ss -tlnp | grep 8772), restart via supervisorctl if unresponsive. (4) Recovery runbook: if rug_pull_monitor stale >14h — run rug_pull_monitor_diagnostic.py to check connectivity, if dead restart via supervisorctl. (5) Circuit breaker (Gate 8): tracks consecutive fails, auto-trips at 3, auto-recloses when a cohort passes. (6) Quarantine: files with 3 consecutive fails are quarantined and never auto-rebuilt. (7) Smoke test execution: runs automatically at build time; individual files exercise their own if __name__ == '__main__' block. (8) Retention: evidence_blob expires at 30 days via query filter, no row deletion.
